newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Monkey King to issue B shares in June.
newsitem.headline: Monkey King to issue B shares in June.

text.p: Welding materials producer Hubei Monkey King Co Ltd will launch an offer of 100 million B shares by mid-June for listing in Shenzhen, a company spokesman said on Monday.
The company has tentatively priced the issue at between 2.5 yuan and 3.5 yuan per share, the spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.
Monkey King has named China Merchants Securities Co as the domestic lead underwriter for the offer and DBS Asia Capital Ltd as the international coordinator, he said.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission, the country's top securities authority, has given Monkey King approval to make the B share offer, the official said.
Monkey King will use proceeds to construct a production base with an annual capacity of 50,000 tonnes of welding materials and make new welding products, the official said.
Monkey King, which has 148 million A shares listed in Shenzhen, posted a net profit of 81.86 million yuan for 1996 against 41.23 million for 1995 based on Chinese accounting standards.

The company's welding materials, which had about a 15 percent share of the domestic market at the end of 1996, are used in the construction of China's multi-billion-yuan Three Gorges Dam project, the official said.
The firm will also supply special welding materials to Qinshan Nuclear Power Plant, based in the eastern province of Zhejiang, the spokesman said.
